findings.claim: Unsigned integer values from 128 through 255 are now always emitted with the uint16 marker (0xcd) instead of the previous uint8 marker (0xcc). This changes serialized bytes and adds a byte for those values, even though the requirement only concerns generator/analyzer crashes, so existing consumers observe an unrelated wire-format change without opting in.

receipt_plan.detail: Using base-built and head-built assemblies, serialize the uint values 127, 128, 200, 255, and 256 with MessagePackSerializer.Serialize<uint> and compare the bytes. Base should encode 128, 200, and 255 as cc 80, cc c8, and cc ff respectively, while head encodes them as cd 00 80, cd 00 c8, and cd 00 ff; 127 and 256 should remain unchanged.
